screening.reason: Trains ML models on the IMPAC dataset and reports a resting-state-fMRI-based external validation (AUROC) of those models on ABIDE I and ABIDE II (Inclusion 2, 3; ABIDE used for an autism-vs-control predictive analysis, not merely cited).

evidence_spans.text: Our model achieves state-of-the-art 80% area under the ROC curve (AUROC) in diagnosis on test data from the IMPAC dataset; and 86% and 79% AUROC on the external ABIDE I and ABIDE II datasets (with further improvement to 93% and 90% after supervised domain adaptation).
evidence_spans.claim: Models trained on IMPAC generalise to ABIDE I and ABIDE II with 86% and 79% AUROC, improving to 93%/90% after supervised domain adaptation.

evidence_spans.text: Participants from all sites of the ABIDE I and ABIDE II were included for external validation, provided both sMRI and rsfMRI were obtained on the same visit. The first avail- able pair of sMRI and rsfMRI scans were used per subject. 1045 subjects from ABIDE I and 761 subjects from ABIDE II met this criteria.
evidence_spans.claim: External validation used all ABIDE I/II sites, restricted to subjects with a paired same-visit sMRI+rsfMRI scan: 1045 ABIDE I and 761 ABIDE II subjects.

evidence_spans.text: Table 3. Demographics of IMPAC participants, ABIDE I participants, and ABIDE II participants. Errors shown are standard deviations. IMPAC ABIDE I ABIDE II Female % 50 15 20 ASD % 46 48 52 Age (years) 17 ± 9.6 17 ± 8.1 17 ± 11 Total participants 915 1045 761
evidence_spans.claim: Demographic breakdown (sex %, ASD %, age, total N) for the IMPAC, ABIDE I and ABIDE II analysed samples.

evidence_spans.text: The IMPAC fMRI and sMRI were processed using the fconn1000 ­pipeline41. For the fMRI connectivity features, the TSE connectivity metric was fit on either the training data alone (IMPAC models) or the entire IMPAC dataset (ABIDE 1 and 2 datasets), and the TSE values per-ROI timeseries for the ABIDE dataset were calculated.
evidence_spans.claim: Processing pipeline (fconn1000) and feature-embedding (TSE) procedure for IMPAC and ABIDE connectivity features.

evidence_spans.text: The features were standard scaled by the mean and standard deviation of the IMPAC dataset.
evidence_spans.claim: ABIDE features were scaled using the IMPAC (training) dataset's mean/SD, not refit on ABIDE itself, limiting cross-dataset leakage.

evidence_spans.text: The top single model trained using IMPAC attained 80.4% AUROC on IMPAC held-out test data. When tested on ABIDE I, it achieved an AUROC of 86.0% (Table 2 underlined) and when tested on the ABIDE II it achieved a performance of 79.2%.
evidence_spans.claim: The top IMPAC-trained model achieved 86.0% AUROC on ABIDE I and 79.2% AUROC on ABIDE II without adaptation.

evidence_spans.text: These tuned models achieved AUROC as high as 93.2% on ABIDE-I and 90.5% on ABIDE-II, roughly a 4–9 basis point increase in performance relative to models without any adaptation.
evidence_spans.claim: Supervised domain adaptation raised AUROC to 93.2% on ABIDE-I and 90.5% on ABIDE-II.

assessments.support: ABIDE I/II inclusion rule and resulting N are explicit: "Participants from all sites of the ABIDE I and ABIDE II were included for external validation, provided both sMRI and rsfMRI were obtained on the same visit. The first avail- able pair of sMRI and rsfMRI scans were used per subject. 1045 subjects from ABIDE I and 761 subjects from ABIDE II met this criteria."
Pipeline (fconn1000), seven atlases, and feature standardisation procedure are described in detail.
Diagnostic label source for ABIDE participants is not described in this paper beyond citing the ABIDE/IMPAC releases.

ABIDE I/II used purely as external, untouched test sets ("not used during model training and hyperparameter optimization"); features were scaled using IMPAC statistics rather than refit on ABIDE (The features were standard scaled by the mean and standard deviation of the IMPAC dataset.), avoiding test-set leakage into preprocessing.

risk_of_bias.summary: Cohort definition, pipeline and external-validation design are clearly reported and leakage-conscious (scaling fit on the training/IMPAC data only); the only gap is the diagnostic label source for ABIDE, which is not described.

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Diagnostic prediction trained on the IMPAC dataset (n=915) and externally validated on ABIDE I (n=1045, all sites) and ABIDE II (n=761, all sites), restricted to subjects with a paired same-visit sMRI+rsfMRI scan.
narrative_row.methods: fconn1000-derived functional connectivity (tangent-space embedding across seven atlases) plus FreeSurfer structural features; 12 ML model types trained/optimised on IMPAC only; ABIDE I/II used as untouched external test sets, with a secondary supervised-domain-adaptation analysis (10-fold CV).
narrative_row.outcomes: Best IMPAC model: 80.4% AUROC (IMPAC); 86.0% AUROC (ABIDE I) and 79.2% AUROC (ABIDE II) without adaptation; 93.2%/90.5% after supervised domain adaptation. Cerebellar connectivity identified as a reproducible discriminative feature.
narrative_row.key_limitations: Exact per-diagnosis Ns for ABIDE are not reported (percentages only); no motion/QC rule or site harmonisation reported for the ABIDE external-validation cohort; diagnostic label source not described.
narrative_row.relevance_notes: A strong example of cross-dataset external validation (IMPAC-trained, ABIDE-tested) with openly released code, pipeline and model weights, directly linking the ABIDE releases to an independently trained predictive model.

kg_link.cohort_description: All ABIDE I and ABIDE II sites, restricted to subjects with a paired same-visit sMRI and rsfMRI scan (first available pair per subject): 1045 ABIDE I subjects (48% ASD) and 761 ABIDE II subjects (52% ASD), used purely as an external test set for models trained on IMPAC.
kg_link.sites: all sites of ABIDE I and all sites of ABIDE II (exact site count not stated in text)
kg_link.pipeline: fconn1000 pipeline (open-source, same version as used in the IMPAC challenge)
kg_link.atlas: BASC (64, 122, 197 ROIs), Craddock (249 ROIs), and other atlases (seven total)
kg_link.finding: IMPAC-trained models achieved 86.0% AUROC on ABIDE I and 79.2% AUROC on ABIDE II without adaptation, rising to 93.2% and 90.5% respectively after supervised domain adaptation.

The first avail- able pair of sMRI and rsfMRI scans were used per subject. 1045 subjects from ABIDE I and 761 subjects from ABIDE II met this criteria.
